DEF. admissible1_list w L ⇔ ∀f∈L, squanderFace(len f)≤w f. 近载体: Graphs.admissible₁ (Graph 面).
DEF. admissible2_list w L: except=0 ⇒ squanderVertex(tri,quad)≤sumn(map w facesAt_list). 近载体: Graphs.admissible₂.

DEF. tame13a_list L ⇔ ∃w, adm1_list∧adm2_list∧adm3_list∧sumn(map w L)<squanderTarget. 近载体: Graphs.tame13a.
DEF(spec). nfloor d x = ⌊x*d⌋ (new_specification 存在性). 近载体: Mathlib Nat.floor; 需新定义 nfloor.
DEF. wt_floor w f = if card f>4 then squanderFace(card f) else nfloor 10000(w f). 近载体: TameLp.bTame/setSum、Graphs.squanderFace.
DEF. adm_1_floor H w ⇔ ∀x∈dart, w(face x)≥squanderFace(card(face x)). 近载体: TameLp.Adm1.
DEF. adm_2_floor H w: no exceptional ⇒ nsum(setOfFace)w ≥ squanderVertex(tri,quad). 近载体: TameLp.Adm2.
DEF. adm_3_floor H w: type=(5,0,1) ⇒ nsum(setOfTriangles)w ≥ excessTCount. 近载体: TameLp.Adm3.
DEF. tame_13a_floor H ⇔ ∃w, adm_1/2/3_floor∧nsum(faceSet)w<squanderTarget. 近载体: TameLp.Tame13a.
